$comment: Third-party license policy for components shipped with opportuniTY (MIT). Checked against the CycloneDX SBOMs of shipped code (non-test .NET projects, npm production dependencies). Default deny: a license must be on 'allowed'. 'denied' patterns (strong/network copyleft) can never be excepted for a linked dependency (Q-38: AGPL only as an optional, unmodified external service). The product owner owns this policy; changes need Security & Compliance review. See docs/ci.md#security-and-supply-chain-gates.
